title: A metadata project's cards live in that project's repo — hotcrm's decision cards included; only platform problems are filed on objectstack/objectui: fix the three SKILL.md rows and the core-rules twins that send them to the objectstack inbox
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (session `session_01MoTv7pn338AZ71owsp19gQ`, GitHub `os-justin`) at 2026-09-10T03:2xZ under the maintainer's direct instruction in this seat's chat session (直派通道; labels set by this seat, ⛔ not a triage grading). Queued, not claimed: it edits `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, which #17285's dev is editing now — **serial after #17285 lands**, ⛔ not folded (different subject).

## 裁决 — the maintainer's words, verbatim and untranslated (chat, 2026-09-10T03:2xZ)

「hotcrm 所有的卡本来就应该在 hotcrm，包括其他元数据项目。除非元数据项目发现平台由问题，给平台立卡片。现在就是这么 操作的」

Read: a metadata project's cards — work cards AND decision cards — live in that project's own repo (hotcrm, and every other metadata project); the only cards a metadata project files on the platform are platform problems it finds, and those go to objectstack / objectui as ordinary platform cards. That is the practice today; the rule text says otherwise in three rows.

## The rows that disagree with the practice (`origin/main` `d64bcb63`)

- `SKILL.md:191` 「单车道仓 `repo:*` 席自理机械三务,⛔ 不产 `domain:*`;**决策卡默认入 objectstack 收件箱**。」 → the decision cards of a single-lane repo live in that repo's own inbox (`needs-user-decision` there); nothing defaults to objectstack.
- `SKILL.md:210` 「**维护者收件箱恒为 objectstack**;在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓。」 → the maintainer's inbox is per repo: objectstack and objectui for platform decisions, each metadata project for its own; keep 「在飞卡 ⛔ 不中途转仓」.
- `SKILL.md:235` 「目标仓不可达时按缝卡规则落 objectstack 带 `repo:*` + 具名读者。」 → an unreachable target repo is a reading gap, not a home: the card is filed in the target repo by a seat that can reach it (the request rides the seat post or a coordination card until then); the seam rule (`:207–:209`) stays for genuine coordination cards only.
- `references/core-rules.md:55/:57` twins: same PR.
- `references/lanes/hotcrm.md:15` 「建设 hotcrm 时发现的平台能力缺口,立普通平台卡到 objectstack 或 objectui。」 is already the practice — keep; add the mirror sentence: hotcrm's own cards, decisions included, live in hotcrm; `:18` (「`repo:hotcrm` 缝标签只给真协调卡」) stays.

## Measured practice, 2026-09-10T03:2xZ

- hotcrm carries the full state label set (`needs-user-decision`, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`, `pm:blocked`, `pm:blocking`, `pm:dispatched`, `pm:epic`, `pm:on-hold`, `pm:queue`, `pm:retriage`, `pm:seat`) and three open decision cards live there today: hotcrm#1819, hotcrm#1498, hotcrm#1199.
- Six open cards labelled `repo:hotcrm` live in objectstack: #17247, #16519, #15009, #14482, #14362, #11617 — by their titles all six are hotcrm work, not platform problems. Their relocation is a separate act (triage's or the hotcrm seat's, transfer preferred over recreate), ⛔ not this card's diff.
- #17250 (decision box) asks the same question for 22 `repo:objectui` cards; this ruling answers the hotcrm half of the pattern and is evidence for that card, ⛔ not a decision on it.

## Acceptance

1. The three SKILL.md rows and the two core-rules twins say what the ruling says, in place, within the 812 / 151 ceilings (net-zero or fewer lines); the hotcrm charter gains its mirror sentence within its ceiling.
2. `pnpm -s check:skill-line-ratchet`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` green; no issue numbers in skill files (cite the ruling by date).
3. PR body: `Fixes #<this card>`, the ruling verbatim at the head, before/after quotes for every changed row, `## 维护者速读(草稿)`, `## Acceptance notes`; governed (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft, four-piece, `skip-changeset`.
4. Serial: opened only after #17285's PR has merged (same file); if #17285's branch moves any of these rows, re-measure before editing.
